basic_info.description: Wonderful two-level townhouse condominium at Telegraph Landing! This beautifully renovated residence offers a sunny living/dining room with wood-burning fireplace opening to a private oasis: an expansive garden patio, perfect for al fresco dining, relaxing and entertaining. The kitchen is appointed with Calacatta gold marble counters, deluxe stainless appliances, and a breakfast bar for informal dining. Around the corner is a half bath for guests with a laundry closet. Upstairs are two generous bedrooms and two recently updated bathrooms, with great closet space and elevator access from the building hallway. The second bedroom features an ensuite tiled bath with shower over a tub, and the primary bedroom boasts a walk-in closet and a sleek bath with a glass-enclosed shower. Engineered wood flooring throughout, deeded 1-car garage parking and a storage space. Telegraph Landing is a pet-friendly building offering a large, recently landscaped central courtyard, common roof decks with sweeping Bay and City views, a club room, a gym, 24-hr security /doorman, and on-site management. This fabulously convenient neighborhood is located a block from the Bay Club, the Embarcadero, and Pier 27, and walkable to the Ferry Building, BART, North Beach and the Financial District.
